name: ARMCL_Dept_Business_agent
business: Ready Mix Concrete (RMC) manufacturing, sales and delivery; Asphalt
scope: Department-based view of ARMCL: which department owns what, their people/roles, activities, rules, KPIs, systems, and data sources
source: downloads/13_JD_ARMCL_Employees.xlsx; downloads/19_Akij_Readymix_Policy.docx (Doc ARL/ARMCL-03/Factory/Dept/03/03); downloads/14_Sales_Manpower_Organogram.xlsx; downloads/10_SOP_and_Policy/; ARMCL Reference Documents master list

departments.role_in_business: Overall SBU leadership: strategy, P&L accountability, cross-functional alignment
departments.head: CEO, ARMCL (reports to Cluster CEO, Akij Building Solutions)
key_activities: Oversee sales, marketing, operations, finance, HR, SCM and support functions
Approve strategy, budget, and high-value/high-risk decisions
Final approval authority as SBU Head (e.g. material rejection)
rules_owned: Material rejection final approval rests with SBU Head
Discount >10% or below breakeven, credit >60 days / >BDT 5 crore require CEO/MD + Finance Head

departments.role_in_business: Corporate strategy, annual business plans, MIS dashboards, trade marketing, target tracking
departments.head: Manager - Planning & Business Operations
key_activities: Annual business plan and budget alignment
5-year strategy plan maintenance
MIS reports, CEO briefing decks, performance reviews for EXCOM/ManCom/Board
Track SBU KPIs and balanced scorecards; highlight gaps
Trade marketing: lifting incentives, RADS achievement offers, tour programs
rules_owned: 100% sales target is mandatory baseline; collection qualifying minimum 90%
Trade monetization programs require CEO approval

departments.role_in_business: Front-line owner of sales: targets, customer acquisition, market visits, collection follow-up
departments.head: Head of Sales (reports to CEO; next level: Cluster CEO ABSL; 5 direct report positions)

Team-A: A S M Shahjalal Sakib (Asst. Manager)

key_activities: Monthly target execution and ADS/RADS tracking
Market visits per ARMCL Market Visit Format
Quotations, order follow-up, contract finalization support
Collection follow-up (0-30 days) and customer relationship management
rules_owned: Detailed sales process rules (KYC, pricing/credit delegation, incentives, complaints TAT, bad debt) are owned at ABSL level - see ABSL_Function_Business_agent.json

departments.role_in_business: Safe, efficient, cost-effective plant operation delivering quality concrete on time
departments.head: Factory Incharge (Plant In-Charge); direct reports: Production Head, Quality Head, Maintenance Head
key_activities: Daily production operations, shift supervision, documentation (Production Engineer)
Machine operation, routine inspection, housekeeping (Batching Plant Operator)
Loading raw materials, stockyard maintenance, safety checks (Wheel Loader Operator)
Casting schedule execution and OEE tracking
Daily production reporting (CUM/CFT)
rules_owned: Only authorized, trained personnel may operate or adjust the batching system
Operations stop immediately on unsafe conditions
All operational, quality, and maintenance records archived for audits
Policy doc ARL/ARMCL-03/Factory/Dept/03/03 (effective 01-07-2025, review 01-07-27)

departments.role_in_business: Ensures consistent quality of raw materials and ready-mix concrete per mix designs and project specs
departments.head: Quality Head / Quality Control Engineer
key_activities: Raw material testing before use (cement, aggregates, water, admixtures)
Slump/cube testing and mix design compliance during batching
Quality records, test reports, inspection logs; daily/weekly/monthly QC reports
QMS procedure implementation
Liaison with production, procurement, and site teams; site visits as needed
rules_owned: Design changes per client demand/weather/road/site conditions require QC Head & Operation Head approval
Material rejection requires documented proof; pre-approval by QC Head, Logistics & Distribution Incharge, Inventory Incharge & Plant Head; final approval by SBU Head

departments.role_in_business: Keeps plant and equipment available via preventive and running maintenance
departments.head: Maintenance Head
key_activities: Preventive maintenance per schedule
Running maintenance; inform production team of issues during running production
Equipment inspection support for operators
rules_owned: Equipment must follow scheduled preventive maintenance
Operations stop immediately on unsafe conditions

departments.role_in_business: Delivers right quantity and quality concrete to site on time; manages lifting plans and transit fleet
departments.head: Logistics & Distribution Incharge / Logistic Supervisor
key_activities: Lifting plan entry and casting schedule alignment
TM dispatch, in-transit quality preservation, site delivery confirmation
Handle site complaints: delay, quality issue, short supply
Ensure correct quantity & quality delivery at site
rules_owned: Site complaints (delay/quality/short supply) handled per Logistic Supervisor SOP
Concrete quality preservation during transit is a department KPI

departments.role_in_business: Financial control: P&L, balance sheet, receivables, VAT, working capital, cost controlling
departments.head: Finance Head / Finance Officer
key_activities: Income statement and balance sheet with budget variance
Customer statement reconciliation
Cheque deposit & receivable posting per SOP
Cost controlling by plant and diesel/fuel monitoring
VAT, depreciation, working capital and cash flow tracking
rules_owned: Cheque deposit & receivable posting must follow SOP_Customer Cheque Deposit & Receivable Posting Process
Overdue beyond 60 days triggers automatic credit hold (per Sales SOP)
Adjustments/write-offs require documented approval per authority matrix
data_sources: downloads/01_Budget_2026-27.xlsx (IS, BS, CF, VAT, Working Capital)
downloads/10_SOP_and_Policy/Copy of SOP_Customer Cheque Deposit & Receivable Posting Process (1).pdf

departments.role_in_business: Manpower planning, JDs, HRBP support, administration, security and office support
departments.head: HRBP / Admin Officer
key_activities: JD maintenance for all ARMCL employees (15 role templates)
Sales manpower organogram and team structuring
HRBP: align HR strategies with business objectives across units
Training and supervision compliance
Office administration, security, housekeeping
rules_owned: Only trained personnel may operate equipment; regular training mandatory
PPE mandatory for all staff; safety protocols must be followed
All key roles require documented JDs and organogram alignment
